function.arguments:
{"title": "Panic: assignment to nil map in store.(*Store).Tag after restoring a reminder from trash", "body": "Crash group 7f3a (4 reports).

Panic: assignment to entry in nil map
Location: store/tags.go:41, store.(*Store).Tag
Caller: api.(*Server).tagReminder
All four reports occurred after a reminder was restored from the trash.

Reproduction: `go test ./store` fails in TestTagRestored with the same panic at store/tags.go:41.

Likely cause (inferred, not confirmed by reading the code): the restore-from-trash path rebuilds the reminder without initializing its tags map. Store.Tag then writes into that nil map. A reminder created normally has the map initialized, so the bug only shows up after a restore. Fix: initialize the map on restore (or lazily in Tag before the assignment), and make sure the restore path goes through the same constructor as creation."}
